significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) predictive coupling and ordering: an internal estimate formed "before any reasoning token is generated" predicts eventual CoT length, is systematically excessive on easy items, and has a monotonic causal relationship to length under steering. This supplies both a phenomenon—easy-item over-budgeting—and a mechanism—a prompt-stage allocation variable—and would constrain whether adaptive-compute policies such as those studied in Snell et al., "Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally Can Be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters," should treat allocation as largely front-loaded or online. The components are determinate, and refuting the pre-token predictive and causal coupling would rule out the proposed front-loaded account, although falsifying the bundled hypothesis could otherwise leave weaker versions intact. Topic substitution fails: efficient reasoning alone would not warrant this score; the specific temporal ordering, predictive coupling, and calibration relation make it stronger than the median separable-direction-and-steering proposal.

reach.justification: The named handles are the "budget probe" for "per-instance budget forecasting" and the single "budget direction" used to recalibrate length; both are ex ante because they operate at prompt time, leaving an action window before reasoning tokens and their cost occur. After per-model re-extraction, the asserted conclusion predicts the same budget-to-length coupling, easy-item miscalibration, and steering response rather than supplying only an unguided search procedure, although the claim explicitly concedes that the direction may require per-model calibration. Its stated scope is reasoning models across tasks, and downstream users include practitioners controlling latency or inference cost on open-weight systems, not merely researchers explaining traces; it does not directly travel outside AI. Topic substitution again fails: the topic by itself supplies no pre-generation forecast or single-shot control handle, so the above-median reach comes specifically from these quoted deliverables.
